$sources: ACI 318-19 Sec 18.2.5-18.2.6, 19.2.1, 20.2.2, 22.2.2; AISC 360-22 (steel G, until the steel track)

sources.seismicFcMin: ACI 318-19 Table 19.2.1.1: special moment frames, special walls, at least 21 MPa
sources.lightweightFcMax: ACI 318-19 Table 19.2.1.1: lightweight concrete in special frames and walls at most 35 MPa (unless tests show otherwise)
sources.lightweightDensity: ACI 318-19 Sec 2.3 (lightweight concrete: equilibrium density 1440-1840 kg/m³)
sources.seismicRebarFy: ACI 318-19 20.2.2.4-20.2.2.5, Table 20.2.2.4(a), 18.2.6: ASTM A706 Grades 420 and 550 in special moment frames and special walls (Grade 280 A615 permitted where it meets 20.2.2.5(b)); Grade 690 only for special walls' flexure, not offered here
sources.fyActualMargin: ACI 318-19 20.2.2.5(b)(i) and ASTM A706: actual yield at most 125 MPa above the specified
sources.fyRetestMargin: ACI 318-08 21.1.5.2(a) retest margin, kept: ACI 318-19 relies on ASTM A706 (SAEngine practice)
sources.fuFyMin: ACI 318-19 20.2.2.5(b)(ii) and ASTM A706: actual tensile / actual yield at least 1.25
sources.rebarGrades: ASTM A615/A615M and A706/A706M specified yield strengths: Grade 40 (280 MPa), 60 (420 MPa), 80 (550 MPa); ACI 318-19 20.2.2.4 (walk 4 W4A-6)
